# Week 7: ranked leans to investigate — comparison revision 2

Comparison revision created 2026-10-20T18:53:28.300076+00:00; forecasts remain immutable revision 2, trained through October 19 / completed week 6. What is supported: three-seed structural precision diagnostics {'stable': 5490, 'unstable': 68}, including zero-role outputs; this measures Monte Carlo precision, not forecast accuracy. What is uncertain: team coherence gaps, unavailable QB replacements, role/script sensitivity and price/settlement freshness ({'current': 3090, 'unavailable': 353}). What is unvalidated: no target passed Amendment-2 model gates; game point forecasts did not beat closing benchmarks; scenario efficiencies are held fixed. Investigation-readiness tiers {'C': 2259, 'B': 1184}; A/B/C are not win probabilities. No bet recommendation or stake. Exact game-roster aliases may resolve names; no suffix/nickname or defensive-player inference. Market comparison/stale flags alone were refreshed; no fit, simulation, or 2026 outcome scoring was performed.

Confidence is investigation-readiness, not predictive accuracy. No validated advantage over closing markets has been established. Structural seed stability does not validate learned-member error or calibration.

A: current compatible consensus, stable, coherent, all member means on one side, all required scenarios available and robust. B: current compatible consensus with uncertainty. C: stale, missing, nonconsensus or incompatible. First TD is offensive rushing/receiving in regulation; quote settlement is unverified, so price gaps are unavailable. Binary outcome quantiles are not confidence intervals on probabilities.

Consensus rule: modal latest line across traditional books, excluding DFS/exchanges; lowest line breaks ties, alphabetical representative. Only consensus rows have gaps. Sum ATD probabilities counts expected distinct scorers, not total TDs. Game margins/lines use home minus away; spread_display gives team plus signed handicap. P(over/under) is strict; p_over_no_push conditions on no push.
